examples.title: Vertical tabs with keyboard navigation
examples.description: A vertical tablist: focus a tab and use ↑/↓ to move. The focus ring must render complete on all sides even though the tab list is a clipping (overflow) container.

examples.title: Tabs with trailing badges
examples.description: Tabs use a decorative `trailing` snippet (wrapped in aria-hidden) for badges and counters. The accessible name only includes the visible label.

examples.title: Tabs with an attention count
examples.description: A tab that holds something needing attention carries an amber count pill from `count`; a healthy tab (zero or no count) carries none. The count is part of the tab’s accessible name, so it never depends on colour.

examples.title: Narrow collapse to a select
examples.description: Below collapseBelow (640px by default) a horizontal tab bar becomes one full-width select reading "Tab: Access". The tabs stay mounted, hidden, so the panels keep their names. This example sets collapseBelow wide enough to show the narrow form at any width.
